publication_decisions: Existing local JPEGs: preserved in canonical repository and history. Publicly accessible repository source is separate from rights-filtered site; each local use requires collection-specific reuse scope reconciliation and attribution, not automatic global clearance.

Permission memo 2026-10-22 explicitly authorizes external source URL display for four identified Muhlenbergia involuta Selected Monocots panels, credited, without pixel modification; do not treat it as a general authorization to republish locally mirrored copies.

For all 118 locally listed Selected Monocots images, site scientific/educational intent and Bob Harms' public notice support educational use with credit, but per-image source provenance, public distribution format, modifications/overlays, and build eligibility remain individually auditable. Do not silently label CC BY.

Leave scientific/image collection holds intact; neither purge credited existing pictures nor automatically replicate any into new species cards. If uncertainty remains about local redistribution/cropping, retain images and seek collection-specific confirmation, or use credited external links without edited pixels.
Independently published Harry Rose CC BY 2.0 Flickr->Commons images are NOT Bob Harms images; do not apply Selected Monocots terms to those photographs.
NC_decision: Current genuinely noncommercial educational site may conditionally use existing independently CC BY-NC photo-specific licensed records with photographer/source/link and change/ShareAlike conditions; no blanket commercial use or silent NC stripping.
